messages:
Alex: Heads-up — user research showed customers are confused when the console shows "degraded route" + a raw 503. They want more context (quota, region failover, or model fallback). Can we add a small 'why' nudge?
Tara: +1. We have 3 separate signals: quota-exhausted, routing-fallback, runtime OOM. Need prioritized mapping.
Ben: Agree. Also telemetry: we should emit a 'failure_context' tag so frontend can render the nudge without parsing text.
Maria: what's the minimal schema? we don't want to release another huge contract.
Ben: Proposal: `failure_context` enum {quota, fallback, capacity, transient} + optional `hint` string and `route_id`.
Alex: sounds good. example payload:
```
{
  "status":503,
  "code":"route_degraded",
  "failure_context":"fallback",
  "hint":"falling back to smaller model (latency up), consider pinning model",
  "route_id":"eu-west-1:route-7"
}
```
Tara: Can frontend show different CTAs? e.g., quota -> "request more capacity", fallback -> "pin model or accept slower path".
Maria: yes but we need standardized CTA keys for i18n. maybe `cta_key` set by server: `request_quota`,`pin_model`,`retry`.
Ben: That pushes schema: `failure_context`,`cta_key`,`cta_url?` keep optional. Use telemetry tag as well: emit `context_hash` for correlation.
Alex: ops-bot relays: deploy-bot will flag any responses missing `failure_context` in next lint run.
ops-bot: note: /deploy linter will start failing on responses without `failure_context` in 2 weeks. See RFC-654 for rollout.
Tara: rollout plan: start with internal beta for Dedicated tenants, flip flag, collect console metric `console.nudge_click`.
Maria: also add dashboard tile: % of 5xx with failure_context=null — goal <5% in 30 days.
Ben: Implementation notes: runtime should map internal enums to public ones. E.g. internal `QUOTA_BURST` -> public `quota`.
Alex: important: do not expose internal routing ids in hint text. redact unless tenant owns that route. route_id ok for telemetry only.
Tara: UX: keep nudges single-line with link to "why this happened" modal. Avoid error verbatim.
Maria: action items: Ben to propose wire for server fallback mapping, Tara to draft CTA copy, Alex to update RFC.
Ben: I'll put a PR up this afternoon for the mapping table + unit tests.
Alex: thanks — if we get the schema right this should reduce support tickets. :thumbsup:
